The '''2004–05 Football League Cup''' (known as the '''Carling Cup''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 45th staging of the [[EFL Cup|Football League Cup]], a knockout competition for England's top 92 [[association football|football]] clubs.  The competition name reflects a sponsorship deal with lager brand [[Carling brewery|Carling]].

The competition began in August 2004 and ended with the [[2005 Football League Cup Final|final]] on 25 February 2005. The [[Millennium Stadium]] in [[Cardiff]] hosted the final match, as it had done since 2001, with the new [[Wembley Stadium]] still not complete.

The winners were [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], beating [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]] in the final 3–2 thanks to an own goal from [[Steven Gerrard]], and goals in extra-time from [[Didier Drogba]] and [[Mateja Kežman]] in extra-time after the match finished 1–1.
